An '''engineer''' was a member of the [[Myke]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Written Word" /> By around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="EssAt">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that the [[Aleph-class starfighter|''Aleph''-class starfighter]] was not produced until around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. Therefore, its name would have had to be derived from the [[Myke (language)|Myke language]] by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] attributed the name of the [[Aleph-class starfighter|''Aleph''-class starfighter]] from a letter in their [[Myke (language)|language]] that resembled the twin-tailed [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Written Word" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Myke engineer was mentioned in "[[The Written Word]]," an article authored by [[John Hazlett]] published on [[StarWars.com]] through [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club]] on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Written Word" />
